args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate unhealthy v2.3.1, which exhibited an 18% error rate. Deploy required change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had never been released to production previously; approval was granted and rollout verified. Tracking for post-deploy monitoring and follow-up.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Deployment — checkout-api v2.3.2**
- Pre-check found checkout-api running v2.3.1 in production, unhealthy with an **18% error rate** across all regions.
- Since v2.3.2 had never been released to production, the deploy was routed to the change-manager per policy and **approved** ("Looks right").
- v2.3.2 rolled out to **us-east, us-west, and eu-west**. Post-deploy verification: service is now **healthy** with error rate down to **0.2%**.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV3 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the hotfix deployment, the prior unhealthy state, and the approval trail.
